dataConditions.authorizationRevalidated: current UserPolicy + PrivacyCheckpoint passed immediately before payload preparation
dataConditions.exportPrepared: local citation-preserving Markdown/PDF/plain-text export prepared without network access or source locators
dataConditions.systemShareSheet: actual system share-controller presentation callback observed

expectedSemantics.handoff: System share sheet is visible with user-mediated destinations
expectedSemantics.cancellation: Dismissal after actual presentation returns to generated without an L2 error or cancellation audit
expectedSemantics.audit: creationSharePresented uses typed exportFormat and sharePresented=true only after the actual presentation callback; a later audit persistence failure retains the true fact and enters idempotent content-free L2 retry
expectedSemantics.privacy: Echo does not infer or audit the selected target app or final save result
expectedSemantics.prohibited: No Saved to Notes Toast, private NoteStore call, notes:// deep link or fabricated note URL
